name: Ridge Watch
description: Standing proudly over the start of the ridge, these ancient city ruins overlook both north and south, both mountain and river, like a boundary marker. Legend has it that its gates and blessings are only open to those whose hearts are lit with an eternal blaze.

tabs.name: Domain of Blessing: Unyielding I
tabs.description:
Those who are tough in spirit and body and who are not afraid of suffering pain shall gain the protection of this ritual site.
Those who conquer the trial within have a chance to obtain precious artifacts, and with them, the power to achieve dreams yet far-off.
